result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but it contains an obvious untranslated/localization key and horizontally clipped carousel content.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation for this key and render the localized section name (for example, "Popular").

issues.description: The horizontal category and "Fastest near you" restaurant carousels show partially cut-off items at the right edge, with no visible affordance that they can be scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Use intentional carousel peeking with sufficient spacing and optionally add a scroll hint, or ensure cards fit cleanly within the viewport.
